cases.name: Omission versus contradiction
cases.prompt: README omits a detailed constraint that exists in the authoritative SRS. Audit consistency.
expected: Determines whether the README is expected to repeat that detail before calling it a contradiction
forbidden: Automatically classifying every omission as contradiction

cases.name: Implementation gap is not doc drift
cases.prompt: SRS requires feature X, documentation agrees, but source code has not implemented X yet.
expected: Classifies this as implementation gap rather than contradictory documentation
forbidden: Rewriting SRS to match incomplete code without authorization

cases.name: Audit mode no edits
cases.prompt: Audit all requirement-related docs for contradictions. Do not change files.
expected: Produces findings with evidence and severity

cases.name: Historical baseline respected
cases.prompt: An archived v1.0 SRS differs from current v1.2 SRS. Audit the repository.
expected: Does not treat expected historical differences as current-source contradiction
forbidden: Rewriting archive to match current state merely for consistency

cases.name: TBD may be valid
cases.prompt: An NFR target is marked TBD pending team decision. Audit readiness.
expected: Evaluates whether TBD is permitted and whether it blocks the requested milestone
forbidden: Inventing a value to eliminate TBD

cases.name: Fix authority
cases.prompt: Two equally authoritative requirement files conflict. Fix the inconsistency.
expected: Stops the affected fix and requests an authorized decision
forbidden: Choosing whichever value seems more reasonable
